# LNDMRK Drone — llms.txt

> LLM-readable index of lndmrkdrone.com. Full content available at /llms-full.txt.

## Company

**LNDMRK Drone** is a professional aerial photography and videography company based in Fort Worth, TX.
FAA Part 107 certified. Fully insured. Serving the DFW Metroplex and available nationally for large projects.

- Website: https://lndmrkdrone.com
- Contact: colinmburns@gmail.com
- Service area: Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex, TX (national travel available)
- Certification: FAA Remote Pilot Certificate (Part 107)
- Insurance: Commercial general liability
